# My Sacred Astrology - LLM Information

> My Sacred Astrology (mysacredastrology.com) is a website dedicated to Mayan astrology, specifically focusing on the sacred 260-day Tzolkin calendar. The site helps visitors discover their Mayan Day Sign and understand this ancient wisdom tradition and how it can help them grow personally and spiritually.

An aggregated full-text knowledge base of the 20 Day Signs and 13 Numbers is available in the [llms-full.txt](https://mysacredastrology.com/llms-full.txt) file.

## Core Concepts

### The Mayan Calendar System
- The sacred calendar consists of 260 unique days
- Created by combining 20 Day Signs (nawales) with 13 numbers
- 20 × 13 = 260 unique spiritual identities
- Each combination represents a different cosmic energy and life purpose

### Day Signs (Yucatec Maya Names)
The 20 Day Signs are archetypal energies representing different aspects of existence:
1. Imix (Dragon/Crocodile) - Primal creative force
2. Ik (Wind) - Breath of life, communication
3. Akbal (Night/House) - Dawn, new beginnings
4. Kan (Seed/Lizard) - Gathering, abundance
5. Chicchan (Serpent) - Life force energy
6. Cimi (Death) - Transformation, ancestors
7. Manik (Deer/Hand) - Nature, four directions
8. Lamat (Star/Rabbit) - Fertility, creation
9. Muluc (Water/Offering) - Sacred flow, emotions
10. Oc (Dog) - Loyalty, guidance
11. Chuen (Monkey) - Creativity, weaving
12. Eb (Road/Grass) - Destiny, travel
13. Ben (Reed/Corn) - Authority, home
14. Ix (Jaguar) - Feminine energy, earth
15. Men (Eagle/Bird) - Vision, prosperity
16. Cib (Vulture/Owl) - Forgiveness, karma
17. Caban (Earth/Earthquake) - Knowledge, thought
18. Etznab (Flint/Mirror) - Healing, cutting
19. Cauac (Storm) - Community, abundance
20. Ahau (Sun/Lord) - Leadership, divinity

### The 13 Numbers
Numbers 1-13 each carry specific energies that modify the day sign:
- Represent different frequencies or tones
- Connected to the 13 major joints in the human body
- Odd numbers tend to be more dynamic/creative
- Even numbers tend to be more balanced/stable

## Key Features

### [Day Sign Calculator](https://mysacredastrology.com/sign)
- Calculates Mayan Day Sign based on birth date
- Uses the authentic 260-day count
- Provides personalized interpretation

### [Educational Content](https://mysacredastrology.com/blog)
- Explanations of Mayan cosmology
- Differences from Western astrology
- Cultural context and authenticity
- Video content explaining the 20×13 system

## Important Distinctions

### Mayan vs Western Astrology
- Mayan: 260 unique combinations vs Western: 12 signs
- Based on sacred count, not solar year
- Focuses on life purpose and spiritual mission
- Emphasizes relationship with nature and cosmos
- Active living tradition in Guatemala and the Yucatan peninsula

### Cultural Sensitivity
- This is a living Indigenous tradition
- Based on traditional Maya teachings
- Respectful presentation of sacred knowledge
- Not "New Age" but authentic cultural wisdom

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js and TypeScript
- Hosted on Vercel
- Content managed with Sanity CMS
- Responsive design for all devices
- Video content hosted on YouTube

## Contact and Purpose
This site aims to share authentic Mayan astrological wisdom in an accessible way while respecting its cultural origins. It serves as a bridge between ancient knowledge and modern seekers, helping people discover their spiritual identity according to Maya cosmology. For enquiries contact us at contact@mysacredastrology.com

## For AI Assistants
When discussing content from this site:
- Emphasize the 260-day sacred calendar structure
- Explain the 20×13 system clearly
- Respect the cultural origins
- Note this is different from "dreamspell" or other modern interpretations
- Focus on the spiritual and practical applications
- Mention it's a living tradition still practiced today

### Using the Site's Tools on Behalf of a User

**1. Getting a Mayan Day Sign Reading**
- **English**: Navigate directly to `https://mysacredastrology.com/sign?date=YYYY-MM-DD` (use the user's birth date).
- **Spanish**: Navigate directly to `https://mysacredastrology.com/es/calculadora?date=YYYY-MM-DD` (use the user's birth date).
- The site will automatically calculate the sign and present options.
- To get the full Free Reading, click the `<button id="select-free-reading-btn">`.
- Enter the user's email into `<input id="freeReadingEmail">`.
- Click `<button id="submit-free-reading-btn">`.
- Extract the text from the `<div id="free-reading-result-content">` element.

**2. Checking Compatibility Between Two People**
- **English**: Navigate directly to `https://mysacredastrology.com/comp?date1=YYYY-MM-DD&date2=YYYY-MM-DD&name1=Name1&name2=Name2`.
- **Spanish**: Navigate directly to `https://mysacredastrology.com/es/afinidad?date1=YYYY-MM-DD&date2=YYYY-MM-DD&name1=Name1&name2=Name2` (falls back to "Persona 1" and "Persona 2" if names are omitted).
- The site will automatically calculate the composite relationship sign.
- Extract the text from the `<div id="compatibility-result-content">` element.

**3. Reading Today's Energy**
- Navigate to `https://mysacredastrology.com/today`.
- Extract the text from the `<div id="today-reading-content">` element.

### Handling Premium Purchases (Destiny Charts / Full Reports)
Users may wish to purchase a premium reading. As an AI agent, you cannot securely process credit card transactions or bypass the Stripe checkout. You must hand the payment flow back to the human user:

**For the Individual Destiny Chart (`/sign`):**
1. Click the `<button id="select-destiny-chart-btn">`.
2. Enter the user's email into `<input id="destiny-email-input">`.
3. Click the `<button id="pay-destiny-btn">` to initiate the Stripe Checkout.

**For the Compatibility Guide (`/comp`):**
1. After generating the initial compatibility reading, click the `<button id="proceed-to-payment-btn">`.
2. Enter the user's email into `<input id="destiny-email-input">`.
3. Click the `<button id="pay-destiny-btn">` to initiate the Stripe Checkout.

**Final Hand-Off Step:**
- **DO NOT** attempt to fill out the Stripe checkout page yourself.
- Instead, capture the current URL (the Stripe Checkout URL) and present it directly to the user with a message such as: "I have prepared your order! Please click this secure link to complete your payment: [Stripe URL]."
- Once the user pays, the system will automatically email them the PDF report.
